{{Quote|I may even be granted the position of ranking distant, which will tie my descendants and bloodline into that of the Family.|Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo|<ref name="OBF" />}}
'''Ranking distant''' was a [[Chiss family/Legends|family]] rank of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. In the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] hierarchy, it was situated above [[Trial-born/Legends|Trial-born]]<ref name="OBF" /> but below the rank of [[Cousin/Legends|cousin]]. Although Chiss could be granted the rank of ranking distant based on merits alone, most were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] into the position.<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> The bloodline and descendants of individuals who held the rank were tied with the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Family]] they were a member of.<ref name="OBF" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Nine Ruling Families are like any other families. Blood and merit create siblings and cousins and ranking distants. Some are released, others are rematched, others are born to trial. The same as any other family.|Aide Chaf'ees'aklaio, to Dean Jinzler|<ref name="SQ" />}}
In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="OBF Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Formbi," was a ranking distant of direct but peripheral [[Chiss family/Legends|family]] lineage among the [[Chaf family/Legends|Fifth Ruling Family]]. In the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], core name "Thrawn," held a [[welcoming ceremony]] for [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]] in a [[welcoming chamber]] at the [[Crustai asteroid base]]. The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]] found the welcoming chamber configuration less elaborate than those featured for the arrival of Aristocra Formbi. He believed that a [[Senior officer/Legends|senior military officer]] of the [[Chiss Defense Fleet]] like Ar'alani didn't rank as highly as a ranking distant of a Ruling Family.<ref name="OBF" />

In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="SQ Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].</ref> [[Aide/Legends|Aide]] [[Chaf'ees'aklaio]], core name "Feesa," of the Fifth Ruling Family explained to [[Dean Jinzler]] how Chiss families were set up. Feesa described how the family rank of ranking distant could be granted based on merits alone, or by blood.<ref name="SQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rank of ranking distant was first mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]''.<ref name="SQ" /> The [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] established Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano as a ranking distant,<ref name="OBF" /> but it is not clear if he had moved in family ranks later. This article assumes he only held the rank of ranking distant in ''Outbound Flight''.
